meta.name: analyze-task
meta.description: Use when a Formax repository task is non-trivial and you should analyze goals, non-goals, boundaries, data/type/interface impact, contract impact, test strategy, and whether an xhigh subagent is actually needed before writing a todo or code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析复杂任务的目标与边界，制定测试策略
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在写代码前系统分析任务范围与影响
copy.tagline_en: Analyze task goals, boundaries, and test strategy before coding
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to systematically analyze task scope and impact before writing code

howto.what: 当处理复杂仓库任务时，Claude 会先输出一份分析简报，明确目标、范围、非目标、各层影响、风险等，并判断是否需要子代理，而不是直接写代码或待办项。
howto.when: 当用户请求对 Formax 仓库中的非琐碎任务（如新功能、跨层变更、复杂 bug）进行分析时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析这个新功能任务的目标和边界。
say.note: Claude 会生成分析简报并询问后续对齐。

say.text: 分析这个跨层变更，先生成简报再写 todo。
say.note: Claude 会先分析影响和风险。

say.text: 这个复杂 bug 需要先分析再决定是否用子代理。
say.note: Claude 会评估并输出分析简报。

howto.what_en: When handling non-trivial repository tasks, Claude first produces an Analysis Brief that clarifies goals, scope, non-goals, layer impacts, risks, and whether a subagent is needed, instead of directly writing code or todos.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to analyze a non-trivial Formax repository task such as a new feature, cross-layer change, or complex bug.

say_en.text: Analyze this new feature task for goals and boundaries.
say_en.note: Claude will generate an Analysis Brief and ask for alignment.

say_en.text: Analyze this cross-layer change; produce a brief before todo.
say_en.note: Claude will assess impacts and risks first.

say_en.text: This complex bug needs analysis before deciding on a subagent.
say_en.note: Claude will evaluate and output an Analysis Brief.
